import argparse
import json
import sys


def build_report(rows):
    return "\n".join(str(row) for row in rows)


def build_report_json(rows):
    return json.dumps([str(row) for row in rows])


def main(argv=None):

    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="print the report as JSON instead of text",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    rows = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in sys.stdin]
    build = build_report_json if args.json else build_report
    print(build(rows))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
